scope: Common semantic conformance with a scripted caller and actual measurement engine

scenarios.property: A failed probe remains a fact while explicit gates and caller assessment stay independent
Caller satisfaction cannot override a failed required check
Incomplete domain preparation retains the Run and can be resumed
Two interpretation revisions preserve original intent and cumulative budget
A revised interpretation cannot weaken a pinned gate
Old facts persist without passing gates for a new submitted subject
Caller notes and source labels cannot create verifier facts
Activity, assumptions and task relationships survive a fresh caller instance
A new check revision cannot inherit the old revision's pass
Earlier measurements survive a later adapter error
A real killed worker retains completed checkpoints without publishing final success
A trusted test module can replace Domain behavior without Core edits
Explicit strict policy continues to require every registered check
A budget handoff can close with a final untrusted assessment and no invented evidence
Old strict request fingerprints and stored records remain readable without automatic execution
One Run cannot cite another Run's verifier observations
The existing agent-tool CLI can prepare, revise, measure, assess and close with separate meanings
Hypotheses, observations, decisions, interpretation revisions and reported task states retain explicit relationships
A known input scope can be measured while final criteria are unknown, then refined within the same Run
Added and revised command timeouts contribute to the owned Job deadline
Dynamic check timeouts cannot extend the Run deadline
Unanswered questions do not mask deadline or budget handoff and closure
Exploratory measurement state stays visible while Domain questions remain
Question omission preserves caller uncertainty and an explicit empty list resolves it
Historical structured Domain questions remain readable and revisions separate caller questions
Completion enforces the declared snapshot rule without creating mandatory assessment or advisory gates
Snapshot copying does not block a different Run from checkpointing measurements
Concurrent identical submissions return one candidate and consume one action
Persistence failure rolls back the Run and cleans the uncommitted snapshot
An input scope revision cannot silently retain an incompatible probe
Structural mode cannot retain an execution probe
Domain-generated check reactivation preserves monotonic revisions
Explicit probe retirement preserves facts and reactivation requires the current revision
Required gates survive attempted retirement and incompatible scope changes
Late spawn failure cannot rewrite a closed Run
Late spawn failure cannot clear a newer Job owner
Job cancellation preserves completed facts and rejects late measurements
A new caller can discover Runs, recover summaries and page exact measurement history
Recovery summaries validate completion record integrity
Recovery retains abandoned captures without moving live captures or published Candidates
Environment discovery alone does not claim Sandbox execution readiness
The actual CLI supports discovery, recovery, history and closure
The checkout launcher works from a foreign directory with Unicode and spaces in the state path
Reordering and insertion preserve existing check references and gate identity
Named checks resolve ambiguous criteria without weakening a gate
Unknown gates are rejected unless their delayed definition is declared
Authorship, Domain generation and unverified approval claims stay separate
Unverified closure is not presented as measurement success
Dynamic checks change the execution set hash while reports are stored only once
Missing referenced facts invalidate a verifier result
Domain implementation or configuration drift is detected despite the same revision label
Read-only recovery queries proceed during an uncommitted writer transaction
Summary output stays small across repeated measurements with substantial content
Historical embedded observation results remain readable without rewriting
CLI stdin and explicit inline JSON work, source errors are actionable, and default status is compact
The default agent-facing Job summary validates every referenced measurement
A closed Run cannot summarize a passing result after canonical measurements are missing
Assessment citations disclose whether they bind the current subject, interpretation and check set
A persisted budget transition replays the same error after caller restart
The copied Skill helper works outside the checkout and restores the same Core Run in a new process
Missing caller state is reported instead of silently creating an empty replacement store
Discovery retains multiple matching Runs without picking a task
The caller helper checks workspace and Domain before forwarding a Run mutation
A lost CLI response is an unknown outcome rather than an automatic new attempt or failed measurement
The real caller CLI preserves failed measurement, repaired Candidate, remeasurement and explicit closeout in one Run
